This Writ Petition, Coming On For Preliminary Hearing In 'B' Group, This Day, Order
texts.facts: The present writ petition has been filed seeking for issuance of writ of mandamus to direct the 6th respondent not to disconnect power connected to the petitioner's manufacturing unit. Such apprehension it is stated is pursuant to the direction of the 4th respondent in letter enclosed at Annexure-D as also direction of the Deputy Commissioner at Annexure-E. 2. It is noticed that the correspondence at Annexure-D makes a reference to certain action sought to be taken against those units which did not have a BIS certificate and in light of such BIS certification there was NC: 2025:KHC-D:10725 HC-KAR contemplated action to cut off the power supply. It is submitted by counsel for the respondents that after such proceedings initiated in the year 2014 there have been subsequent developments.
